title: ghud-plugin.toml
description: A ghud Plugin's manifest, written in TOML at the root of the Plugin's directory. This schema checks it decoded to JSON.

name.description: The Plugin's name: lower-case letters, digits and dashes. Installed Plugins live in plugins/<name>/.

protocol.description: The protocol version the Plugin speaks; ghud refuses other versions with needs setup.

command.description: The program to run, with its arguments, never through a shell. A path with a slash is relative to the Plugin's directory, which is also its working directory; a bare name is looked up on PATH.

build.description: Steps `ghud plugin install` runs in the Plugin's directory, in order, with no stdin and no shell.

widget.description: The Widget types the Plugin provides, as [[widget]] tables.

duration.description: A Go duration such as "30s", "5m" or "1h30m".

type.description: The `type` a [[widget]] block in config.toml names; unique across ghud and every Plugin.

title.description: The default title in the Widget's top border.

description.description: One line above the type's block in `ghud config default`.

refresh.description: How often ghud sends widget/refresh; omitted is only at start and after Actions.

floor.description: The shortest `refresh` a user may set; shorter ones are clamped.

default.description: Place a Widget of this type when config.toml places none.

setting.description: The keys a [[widget]] block of this type takes, as [[widget.setting]] tables.

name.description: The key, other than type, id, title and refresh, which every Widget takes.

why.description: When you'd change it; the config reference prints it.

choices.description: The only values a string setting accepts.

required.description: Add Widget writes the setting, at its default, into the block it appends.
